recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast urban scene featuring a black and white stencil of a couple embracing against a textured red and orange brick wall, framed by heavy black vignettes and distressed, spray-painted typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast stencil figures against a warm, textured background
Rough, dripping typography framing the central subject
Heavy black vignette focusing attention on the central kiss
Juxtaposition of romantic subject matter with aggressive street art textures
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white character rendering
Warm red-to-yellow color gradient on the wall

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of contact between the two faces in the stencil.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the central figures, and settles on the bottom text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black borders create a claustrophobic, focused frame around the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and burnt orange brick tones providing the mid-ground warmth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the stencil silhouettes and vignette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and yellow for the spray-painted text and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white paint and black shadows; high saturation in the red brick center fading to black.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, thick strokes with irregular, jagged edges
Vertical paint drips extending from the bottom of characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Crossed-out or 'X' motifs within circular or square letters
Dripping paint tails on all horizontal base strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast color pairing (white vs yellow) with shared stencil-grunge DNA.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the clean stencil look for the bottom text.
Provides the dripping, aggressive spray paint look for the top text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a gritty red and orange brick wall background with a heavy black vignette. In the center, place a high-contrast black and white stencil of a couple embracing and kissing, styled like urban street art.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, dripping spray-paint style text at the top. Add a two-line blocky yellow stencil-style text at the bottom center. Ensure both text elements look like they were applied directly to the wall texture.

verificationChecks: Is the brick texture visible through the paint?
Are the drips on the top text vertically consistent?
Is the vignette deep enough to hide the corners of the wall?

adjustableVariables: Length and density of the paint drips
Level of detail in the stencil figures
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the couple
Exact letter shapes and drip patterns
Unique graffiti tags in the background
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic paint splatter and overspray
Ensure the yellow text has a 'cut-out' stencil appearance
Verify the central figures are rendered in a 2-3 tone stencil style
Confirm the vignette doesn't obscure the central kiss
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Stencil + Brick Texture + Dripping Typography + High Contrast Silhouette
